name: Agentic RAG Research Assistant
description: An AI research assistant that processes documents, retrieves relevant information and uses an agentic workflow to generate answers.
problem: Users need to retrieve useful information from large documents without manually searching through them.
solution: Documents are processed into embeddings and stored in a vector database. An agent performs retrieval, evaluates relevance and generates an answer using an LLM.
architecture: PDF/document → embeddings → vector database → agentic retrieval → verification → answer

name: Autonomous Data Analyst
description: An AI-powered data analysis system that understands datasets, performs analysis and generates insights.
problem: Analyzing datasets manually requires multiple steps including data understanding, querying, analysis and visualization.
solution: An AI agent analyzes the dataset, determines the required operations and uses Python or SQL to generate insights and visualizations.
architecture: CSV/Excel → data understanding → Python/SQL → analysis → visualization → insights

name: MCP-Powered Personal Assistant
description: An AI assistant that interacts with external resources through Model Context Protocol tools.
problem: AI agents need standardized ways to interact with external tools and resources.
solution: The AI agent uses MCP to discover and interact with tools such as filesystem, database and GitHub resources.

name: Multi-Agent Recruitment System
description: A multi-agent recruitment system that uses specialized agents for resume analysis, job description analysis, candidate matching and interview recommendations.
problem: Recruitment involves multiple stages that can require significant manual effort.
solution: Specialized AI agents divide recruitment tasks and collaborate to produce candidate recommendations.
architecture: Resume Agent → JD Agent → Matching Agent → Interview Agent → Recommendation

name: P&ID Vision Agent
description: A computer vision agent designed to detect and analyze symbols in P&ID diagrams.
problem: Identifying engineering symbols in P&ID diagrams manually can be time-consuming.
solution: A vision pipeline detects symbols in P&ID images and performs further analysis to support engineering reporting.
architecture: P&ID image → YOLO detection → symbol identification → relationship analysis → engineering report
